newsitem.title: USA: WinStar sells $300 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: WinStar sells $300 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following two-part 144a high-yield corporate bond offering from WinStar Communications Inc was priced on Thursday morning via lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston, according to market sources.
WinStar is a competitive local exchange carrier that provides local, long distance and Internet access services to small- and medium-sized businesses using wireless technology.
